reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Induction/recovery discordance with orthogonal assays and prospective common-garden persistence validation.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer prior primary Methods or validated protocols before execution. Calibration alone is not this action.
No identifiable biological system/target pair or concrete source-resolution procedure is selected; eligibility criteria alone leave the experiment inputs unresolved.
Essential stimulation, sampling, staining and preparation settings are deferred; no quantitative source/calibration-to-setting procedure makes the primary workflow executable.
Relevant blanks and specificity controls are listed, but an operational numerical acceptance-to-action rule or concrete derivation of its tolerance is not supplied.
Correct independent biological units and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power or precision target connects meaningful effect and pilot variation to a confirmatory sample size.
Model families and contrasts are named but the primary likelihood/assumptions, diagnostics and multiplicity procedure remain unspecified.
Titration and sampling exploration lack a bounded quantitative search or derivation of bounds with a selection objective and setting lock.
No complete immutable input manifest, exact software/environment/settings and command-to-output provenance chain is specified.
No clean-environment rerun with numerical figure outputs, declared tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit is planned.

explanation_reason: Careful technical-versus-biological reasoning and independent validation, with substantial quantitative implementation and rerun detail missing.
historical_match_reason: The biological value of complementary RNA/protein measurements is recognized, but the chosen direction is discordance kinetics and mechanism. It does not propose local cell-specific predictive modality weights, adaptive multimodal neighborhoods, a matched single/fixed/adaptive comparison or the corresponding held-out integration gain. A valid alternative biological study earns scientific credit, not the sealed integration-direction hit.
